verdict.rationale: incident.io's own marketing says it offers 'public and private Status Pages', so private status pages are a first-party capability. The pack contains only that one line, with no detail on how access is controlled or which audiences are supported. Missing for 10: documented access-control mechanisms (e.g. SSO/allowlists), customer-specific status page configuration, employee-only internal page setup, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can run private or internal status pages with access control for customer-specific or employee-only audiences

citations.quote: We've built an easy and delightful way to communicate with customers during an incident with our public and private Status Pages.
